components.name: Primary Button (Ink)
components.description: The register's action button; ink fill, paper text, cloth-green on hover.

components.name: Secondary Button (Outline)
components.description: Quiet alternative on paper; used for Report another, New report.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:8px; background:#efe5cd; border:1.5px solid #1e2a38; border-radius:2px; padding:12px 22px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.03em; color:#1e2a38; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .12s ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:#f6efdd; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c33b2e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Stamped Tabs

components.css: .ds-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; border:1.5px solid #1e2a38; background:#efe5cd; } .ds-tabs-btn { padding:11px 8px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:12.5px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5a5140; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs-btn + .ds-tabs-btn { border-left:1.5px solid #1e2a38; } .ds-tabs-btn[aria-pressed="true"] { background:#1e2a38; color:#f6efdd; } .ds-tabs-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c33b2e; outline-offset:-2px; }

components.name: Field
components.description: Paper field with an ink rule border; 16px text so phones never zoom.
components.css: .ds-field { display:block; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:6px; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5a5140; } .ds-field-input { width:100%; background:#efe5cd; border:1.5px solid #1e2a38; border-radius:2px; padding:11px 12px; font-size:16px; font-weight:500; color:#1e2a38; caret-color:#1e2a38; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color:#675d4b; font-weight:400; } .ds-field-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #c33b2e; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Entry Strip
components.description: The viewer's own line, bracketed in red at the margin — the register's personal entry.
components.css: .ds-entry { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px; margin:0 16px; background:#efe5cd; border:1.5px solid #1e2a38; padding:11px 14px 11px 23px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-entry::before { content:''; position:absolute; left:7px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); width:8px; height:34px; border:1.5px solid #c33b2e; border-right:0; } .ds-entry-roll { font-size:13px; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:0.04em; color:#5a5140; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-entry-rank { font-family:'Zilla Slab','Roboto Slab',Georgia,serif; font-weight:600; font-size:29px; line-height:1.05; color:#1e2a38; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } .ds-entry-rank small { margin-left:7px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.12em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5a5140; } .ds-entry-meta { margin-left:auto; text-align:right; } .ds-entry-meta span { font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#5a5140; }

components.name: The 75% Line
components.description: The signature threshold rule drawn in red ballpoint between confirmed and below-minimum rows.

components.css: .ds-status { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; font-family:'Public Sans',system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:11px; font-weight:700; letter-spacing:0.16em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#6e5410; } .ds-status i { width:8px; height:8px; border-radius:50%; border:1.5px solid #8a6a12; background:#8a6a12; display:inline-block; } .ds-status-open { color:#5a5140; } .ds-status-open i { background:transparent; border-color:#5a5140; } .ds-status-resolved { color:#2f5c46; } .ds-status-resolved i { background:#2f5c46; border-color:#2f5c46; }

narrative.northStar: The Class Register, Open on the Desk.
narrative.overview: The product is the college's cloth-bound attendance register, run as a working table. Manila paper is the ground; a single cloth-green band binds the head; rows are ruled like a register page; the teacher's red ballpoint marks what matters — the 75% line, stamps, corrections. Nothing floats in glass, nothing glows: structure comes from hairlines and ink. Typography carries the register's two voices: Zilla Slab, a printed-form serif for heads and numbers read off the master page, and Public Sans, a form-and-data workhorse for everything read in a corridor between classes. Figures are tabular everywhere they can be compared, so columns align the way a register's do. The world serves the task, never the reverse: navigation, search, filters, and sorting are the platform's standard controls wearing the register's ink.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground (#e7dcc3) with one cloth-green (#3f6457) head band per surface.
Ruled rows, not cards: 1px hairline rules, 1.5px ink head rules, squared corners (1-2px).
Red (#c33b2e / #a62f22) reserved for the 75% threshold, stamps, and corrections.
Tabular numerals on every rank, roll, percentage, count, and clock time.
Functional micro-labels: uppercase, tracked 0.14-0.22em, never under 11px.

rules.name: The Red Pen Rule
rules.body: Red is correction ink: threshold rules, stamps, below-minimum figures, down states. It never paints a background, never decorates, and never marks something that is fine.

rules.name: The Cloth Band Rule
rules.body: One cloth-green field per surface, at the head, carrying the wordmark and at most one stamp. It is the register's binding, not a utility bar.

rules.name: The Tabular Register Rule
rules.body: Any figure that can be compared uses font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and a right-aligned column. Columns align by their figures, not by luck.

rules.name: The Printed Label Rule
rules.body: Functional micro-labels never drop below 11px and never run tracked body text above 0.05em. Tracking is for short uppercase labels only.

rules.name: The Sheet Rule
rules.body: Phones get the register edge to edge; desktops get one sheet on the desk. Never two overlapping panels, never a card grid.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Before reaching for a shadow or a heavier border, reach for a rule. Structure is drawn, not elevated.

rules.name: The Printed Form Rule
rules.body: Corners are square unless the shape is a ring or a dot. A 6px colored side stripe is a costume; a drawn bracket is a mark.

dos: Do keep rows ruled: 1px hairline rules between rows, a 1.5px ink rule under column heads.
Do keep figures tabular and columns right-aligned; ranks, rolls, percentages, counts, uptimes, and clock times.
Do keep the viewer visible: bracketed entry strip when ranks are known, bracketed row + YOU stamp in the list.
Do keep times IST 12-hour AM/PM everywhere, including tooltips.
Do keep form controls at 16px on phones and focus rings 2px red at 2px offset.
donts: Don't use red as a background, gradient, or decoration; it is correction ink only.
Don't introduce cards with rounded corners, glass blur, gradient text, or dark backgrounds — the discarded look is the anti-reference.
Don't use emoji or unicode glyphs as icons; draw SVG in one stroke voice (1.5-2px, round caps).
Don't use monospace faces; tabular Public Sans carries all data.
Don't let functional labels fall under 11px or track body text above 0.05em.
